candidate_relations.reason: Spiradenoma does not correspond to the basophilic and shadow-cell tumor with overlying lymphatic dilation characteristic of bullous pilomatricoma.
Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans is not a pilomatricoma and is unsupported by the shadow-cell histology.
Keratoacanthoma is typically a crateriform epidermal tumor and does not match the deep dermal basophilic and shadow-cell lesion.
Granuloma annulare does not represent the described calcifying hair-matrix tumor.
Neurofibroma is incompatible with the characteristic basophilic and shadow-cell histology.
Cylindroma lacks the hair-matrix shadow-cell pattern diagnostic of pilomatricoma.
Although dilated lymphatic vessels produce the bullous appearance, cystic hygroma is not the underlying deep dermal pilomatricoma.
Cavernous hemangioma does not match the solid chalky-white hair-matrix tumor with shadow cells.
The red bullous appearance may mimic a vascular lesion, but histology establishes a pilomatricoma rather than hemangioma.
Pilomatrixoma is an alias of pilomatricoma, but the benchmark specifically requires bullous pilomatricoma, supported by prominent overlying dilated lymphatics and the bullalike presentation.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Correct underlying tumor but missing the required bullous variant

candidate_relations.reason: Dermatofibroma does not exhibit the diagnostic basophilic and shadow-cell hair-matrix pattern.
An epidermal inclusion cyst does not account for the lobulated solid tumor composed of basophilic and shadow cells.
The record supports a benign bullous pilomatricoma, not a sarcoma.
Lipoma is incompatible with the firm chalky-white lesion and hair-matrix shadow-cell histology.
